rules: Headings must use tracking-tighter for a modern, sleek look.
Overlines must be uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs.
DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for headings.
Use zinc-950 instead of pure black for subtle warmth.
Primary CTA should be Emerald to signify money, growth, and trust.
Surface borders should be 1px solid border-zinc-800.
High contrast text visibility is mandatory.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_system: Generous spacing. p-8, p-12, p-24, gap-8
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode) for Features, Control Room for Calculator
rules: Containers with borders must have internal padding (e.g., p-8).
Never center everything by default. Use left alignment for body and dense content.

components_strategy.buttons: Shadcn based. Primary buttons are solid emerald with dark text. Secondary are outline with subtle hover. Apply data-testid.
components_strategy.cards: 1px border-zinc-800, bg-zinc-900. Flat, rectangular, max rounded-2xl.
components_strategy.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/70) with 1px border-b border-white/5.
components_strategy.calculator: Use Shadcn Sliders for interactive slots/price/days adjustment. Monospace font for numerical outputs.
components_strategy.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs for the Waitlist Buyer/Seller toggle.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use CSS radial-gradient or grain image overlay for the background to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for header and sticky CTAs. High blur (backdrop-blur-xl) with subtle 1px border.
visual_enhancers.logos: Use 'react-icons/si' for brand logos in the Services grid (e.g., SiNetflix, SiSpotify, SiCanva).

sections.name: Hero
sections.intent: High impact, build instant trust. Dual CTAs.
sections.layout: Left-aligned dominant heading (Outfit font) + right-aligned abstract composition or bento-style floating cards representing subscriptions.
sections.content: Headline: 'Share Subscriptions. Zero Scams.', Subheadline: 'SLOTU is India’s trusted escrow marketplace for sharing digital slots safely.', CTAs: 'Browse Slots', 'Sell a Slot'.

sections.name: How it Works
sections.layout: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode) or staggered horizontal timeline (Browse -> Pay -> Receive -> Done). Use subtle borders and icons.

sections.name: Services Grid
sections.intent: Showcase the massive scale of supported platforms.
sections.layout: Infinite Marquee (using react-fast-marquee or CSS animation) with oversized Si Icons from react-icons/si. Muted zinc-600 icons that light up on hover.

sections.name: Trust & Escrow
sections.intent: Explain the escrow feature (Protected under IT Act 2000 Section 79).
sections.layout: Split section. Left: Trust Padlock image with green glow. Right: Accordion or stacked list of trust features (Verified Sellers, Instant Delivery, Escrow Hold).

sections.name: For Sellers / Calculator
sections.intent: Convince users to monetize unused slots. Earnings calculator.
sections.layout: Bento Grid. Left: Interactive calculator (Sliders for Slots, Price, Days) showing Total Earnings in massive text. Right: Seller profile image with success metric overlay.

sections.name: Pricing Transparency
sections.layout: 2-column pricing cards. 'Standard' (5-8% commission) vs 'Pro' (₹199/mo). High contrast, crisp borders.

sections.name: Waitlist Form
sections.layout: Centered form inside a subtle glassmorphic card. Includes Buyer/Seller toggle, Name, Email, and large Emerald CTA button.

sections.name: Footer
sections.layout: Multi-column standard footer. Dark zinc-950 background. Large 'SLOTU' text watermark. Links to ToS, Privacy, Grievance Officer.

trust_padlock.description: Abstract dark glowing padlock for the Trust/Escrow section.
trust_padlock.usage: Place in the Trust & Escrow section, ideally with a subtle mix-blend mode or dark gradient overlay.

seller_profile.description: Young Indian Gen Z man in cinematic dark lighting, representing a successful seller.
seller_profile.usage: Place next to the Earnings Calculator in the 'For Sellers' section.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building the UI strictly in dark mode. Do not implement a light/dark toggle. Hardcode the dark theme visually using tailwind `zinc-950` backgrounds and `zinc-50` text.
Configure Tailwind font family: sans -> 'Manrope', display -> 'Outfit'.
Install dependencies: `yarn add lucide-react react-icons framer-motion`.
Use standard HTML structure combined with Tailwind classes. Do NOT abstract structural layout elements (like Hero, Section) into Shadcn cards.
Shadcn is ONLY for interactive elements: Button, Input, Slider (for Calculator), Tabs (for Waitlist toggle).
CRITICAL: Apply `data-testid` to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, sliders, toggles).
Ensure the Earnings Calculator in the Sellers section has state (React useState) for 'slots', 'price', and 'days', and dynamically updates the 'Total Earnings' text.
For the Services Grid, implement an infinite scrolling marquee using CSS or framer-motion, displaying `react-icons/si` (e.g., `<SiNetflix />`, `<SiSpotify />`, `<SiCanva />`, `<SiPlaystation />`).
